stats.text: Armor training allows you to use armor of a certain category without the following drawbacks. If you wear Light, Medium, or Heavy armor and lack training with it, you have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on any {ref:glossary/d20-test} that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can't cast spells. If you use a {ref:equipment/shield} and lack training with it, you don't gain its AC bonus. *See also* "Disadvantage" and "Equipment" ("Armor").
